subject: One-company stress gauntlet: force Powers, Frappe, Model Commons, Format Commons and partner organs through shared causal work

body.scenario: Run a bounded Aurekai operating-day simulation as one company, not separate product demos. Use real local code/state and tiny representative artifacts.
lanes: Customer-to-cash: lead/contact/support signal -> CRM/Helpdesk -> quote/order/invoice/accounting projection -> MoneyGraph evidence -> Insights. Exercise registered Frappe lineages through shared objects rather than nine isolated demos.

Engineering-to-partner: external issue/ForeignTwin -> bounded WorkGraph task -> provider/native execution -> SARIF/VEX/OTel evidence -> DSSE/ReceiptEnvelope -> independent review -> Partner Commons update.
Knowledge-to-action: Wiki/Drive/CMS content -> ContextCompiler/GigaToken/CaveMem/RTK -> model route -> decision contract -> effect -> replayable ProofBundle.

Artifact supply chain: one tiny semantic object projected through several Format Commons families, stored/content-addressed through ObjectFabric/OpenDAL, compressed when useful with Zstd, then recovered and hash-verified. Use Iroh/QUIC only if an existing local path is available; otherwise return an exact bounded block.

Model route: use already-available local/open/paid providers and native model powers where installed. Exercise FPQ/SLI/Reason/Physics/Leapfrog/Net-family capabilities only through real registered paths; no giant model download.
Operations: worker lifecycle must pass AgentSession/WorkerRun/Restate/ProtocolMachine semantics; provider process IDs cannot become lifecycle identity.
body.native_power_rule: Select combinations from the 91 registered Powers by dependency/capability closure. Record which Powers were actually invoked and what novel cross-organ composition they enabled. Do not rename them into generic helpers.
body.acceptance: At least three lanes must cross five or more distinct Generation-10 owner families and converge on reusable proof/evidence. Any lane that cannot run must emit a bounded blocker instead of a fake success.
